justification: The outer 17-cycle is Hamiltonian and thus a largest possible main ring. All omitted edges are zero-length bridges. The 1–10 bridge splits it into paths with 8 and 7 internal carbons, more symmetrically than the other bridges. Longest-path-first numbering gives secondary bridges 3,8 and 12,16; the reverse admissible numbering ties. Ring-edge separations are linear, unlike the gonane graph. No stereochemistry is implied.
